evidence.snippet: We present SafeVLA-Bench, a post-hoc safety-evaluation framework for existing simulator-based VLA benchmarks.

claire_radar.motivation: Vision-language-action (VLA) benchmarks measure whether a policy completes a requested manipulation task, but binary success can hide safety-relevant trajectory behavior: reaching the goal while applying excessive contact, disturbing bystander objects, destabilizing the held object, or entering robot self-contact.
